# CogniGuide

> > AI-powered learning platform that generates flashcards and quizzes from PDFs, DOCX, and PowerPoint files using spaced repetition and active recall techniques.

CogniGuide transforms study materials into intelligent flashcards and quizzes across subjects from elementary math to computer science (Python, Java, JavaScript, C++) and professional exams (ABO, EMT). The platform leverages AI to automate study deck creation from uploaded documents with scientifically-proven learning methodologies.

## Key Topics

- AI flashcard generation
- Spaced repetition learning
- Active recall
- PDF to flashcards conversion
- Document upload (PDF, DOCX, PPTX)
- Exam preparation
- Computer science programming (Python, Java, JavaScript, C++)
- Study automation
- Quiz generation
- Elementary math education
- Professional certification (ABO, EMT)
- AI study tools
- Text to flashcards
- Multiple-choice practice tests

## AI Flashcard Tools

- [AI Flashcards for Free & Ace Your Exams](https://www.cogniguide.app/flashcards/ai-flashcards-for-free): Free AI flashcards from PDFs with spaced repetition learning
- [Instant AI Flashcard Maker from Text](https://www.cogniguide.app/flashcards/ai-flashcard-maker-from-text): AI flashcard maker converting text, PDF, DOCX & PPTX to study decks
- [AI for Studying Flashcards: Master Any Subject Fast](https://www.cogniguide.app/flashcards/ai-for-studying-flashcards): AI-powered study flashcards with spaced repetition for any subject
- [AI Flashcards from PDF: Study Smarter Now](https://www.cogniguide.app/flashcards/1-10): Generate 1-10 flashcards from PDF, DOCX & image files instantly
